name: TimePad
description: Control a local TimePad timer. Log in below, then "use <project>" from the search bar to pick a project - start/task need one selected (remembered until you change it). Then: "start <task>", "task <name>" (or "start <project>: <task>"/"task <project>: <name>" to use a different project once, which also becomes the new remembered one), "stop", "current", "dashboard", "project <name>".

configSchema.label: JWT token (set automatically by logging in below)
